issues.description: The template constructor for the two-qubit Grover class defines the query register as self._query_register but then constructs the QuantumCircuit with self.query_register (a different attribute name). This mismatch will cause an AttributeError when students instantiate the class and prevents following the intended exercise. The solution repository uses self.query_register consistently, indicating the template name is an accidental typo rather than an intended pedagogical gap.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the attribute name consistent in the template. Replace self._query_register = QuantumRegister(...) with self.query_register = QuantumRegister(...) or change the QuantumCircuit construction to use self._query_register. Prefer matching the solution and problem wording: use self.query_register and then QuantumCircuit(self.query_register).

issues.description: The template class for Exercise 1 declares the query register attribute as self._query_register but then constructs the QuantumCircuit using self.query_register (an attribute that is not defined in the template). The solution uses self.query_register consistently. This inconsistent identifier naming for the same conceptual entity (the query register) in the template will confuse students and lead to a runtime/attribute error when they instantiate the template.
issues.suggestedFix: Rename the attribute in the template to match the solution and the rest of the code: replace self._query_register with self.query_register (and use self.query_register consistently when creating the QuantumCircuit), so the query register identifier is the same across template and solution.
